raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions has 4835 rows but only 4814 distinct txn_id, which looks like transactions re-delivered in later batches. silver_transactions filters to POSTED and does no dedup, so the duplicates flow into silver and every gold table. I could not see the duplicate rows, so the fix assumes the latest delivery (highest batch_id/ingest_ts) is the authoritative version of each txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
